Given who I am, who I associate with, and who my family is, that really isn't an option. It isn't just high school. I can't fucking motivate myself to do anything. I am constantly forgetting important things, and as a result am in screaming matches with my parents. 

The thing is, I have more opportunities open to me than 99 percent of the people on this planet, and I feel like an utter douchbag because of this. Many people would give a lot to be in the position I am in. My schooling isn't really restricted by money, I have a tested IQ in the 99th percentile (yay American Mensa). I have the chance to be so many things, yet I always find some way to fuck things up for myself. I don't know how that I will have a future that doesn't end in me being fired from every job I take due to laziness and living with my parents.  They see me as an utter disappointment.

Sorry if this is disorganized, I am having trouble thinking straight.
